title: Registration
summary: Registration fees, author policies, key deadlines, and attendee information for IEEE SSCI 2027.

paragraphs: Registration Information and Author Policies
IEEE SSCI 2027 will be held primarily in person on the Gold Coast, Australia, with a remote presentation option available for accepted papers.
Standard conference registration fees (excluding Tutorial-only Registration) include:
bullets: Access to the full IEEE SSCI 2027 technical program
Admission to keynote and plenary sessions
Access to industry and government sessions and panel discussions
Coffee breaks and lunches, as specified in the conference program
Admission to the Welcome Reception and Conference Banquet

sections.heading: Registration Information
paragraphs: All registration fees are in Australian Dollars (AUD). Unless otherwise specified, all deadlines are at 11:59 PM AoE (Anywhere on Earth) on the stated date.
For registration-related enquiries, email ssci2027@intelliaevents.com.au.

sections.heading: Early Registration Fees
paragraphs: Deadline: 15 January 2027

actions.label: Register Here!
actions.note: The registration system is under testing and will be online soon.

sections.heading: Author Registration
paragraphs: Author Registration Deadline: 24 December 2026

Registration is required for ALL accepted contributions to IEEE SSCI 2027, not only Full Papers. This includes Full Papers, Short Papers, Late-Breaking Papers, Poster-only Abstracts, and Journal-to-Conference (J2C) presentations.
For accepted Full Papers, at least one NON-STUDENT registration must be associated with each paper for the paper to be included in the IEEE SSCI 2027 proceedings and submitted to IEEE Xplore.

Only accepted Full Papers will be included in the IEEE proceedings. Other accepted contribution types are presentation-only but still require registration to be included in the conference program and presented at IEEE SSCI 2027.

sections.heading: Additional Accepted Papers
paragraphs: An author with multiple accepted papers may use the Subsequent Paper Registration option.
Subsequent paper fee: AUD 400 per additional paper, with a maximum of two papers covered under an author registration.

sections.heading: Extra Page Charges for Full Papers
paragraphs: Full Papers may be up to 6 pages, plus 1 page for references. A maximum of two extra content pages per Full Paper is allowed, up to 8 pages plus 1 page for references, with an additional charge per extra page.
Extra page fee: AUD 180 per additional content page

sections.heading: Invitation Letter
paragraphs: The registration confirmation and the official invitation letter will be issued and sent together automatically after successful registration.
Authors and attendees do not need to request the invitation letter separately after completing their registration.
Participants who require a visa to travel to Australia are strongly encouraged to register early and begin their visa application process as soon as possible after receiving the invitation letter.

sections.heading: Cancellation, Refund and Transfer Policy
paragraphs: Requests for cancellation received on or before 15 January 2027 are eligible for a refund subject to the following administrative fees:
No registration refunds will be provided after 15 January 2027.
Standard conference registrations are transferable. Discounted registrations are not transferable.
